entry.name: jit.gl.mesh
entry.description: Creates a geometric surface from a jit.matrix connected to the left-most inlet containing spatial coordinates. Additional geometry can be specified by attaching other jit.matrix or jit.gl.buffer objects to the other inlets.

attributes.name: auto_colors
attributes.digest: Automatic calculation of colors
attributes.description: Enables or disables the calculation of vertex colors (default = 0).

attributes.name: auto_normals
attributes.digest: Automatic calculation of normal directions
attributes.description: Enables or disables the calculation of normal directions used for calculating lighting (default = 1).

attributes.name: auto_tangents
attributes.digest: Automatic calculation of tangent directions
attributes.description: Enables or disables the calculation of tangent directions (only available if texcoords and normals exist) (default = 0).

attributes.name: smooth_tangents
attributes.digest: Enable smooth tangent calculations
attributes.description: Enables smooth tangents calculations whenis enabled (default = 0). When on, tangent generation enables a secondary smoothing process, which can improve the look of tangent based effects (e.g.heightmap) at the cost of extra processing.

messages.name: (drag)
messages.digest: Drag and drop a Jitter material file

messages.name: color_matrix
messages.description: Specifies a matrix of color values. This must be the same size as the matrix specified by themessage, and can be a 3 or 4 plane matrix.

messages.name: index_matrix
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol, specifies a matrix of indices. It can be any size, but it must have 1 plane and be an integer matrix.

messages.name: jit_gl_buffer
messages.description: Bind aobject to this mesh. When bound, the buffer data is used by the mesh when rendering. The mesh inlet determines how the data is used (e.g. as color data or normal data), but this can be overridden by theattribute.

messages.name: normal_matrix
messages.digest: Specifies a matrix of normal values
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol, specifies a matrix of normal values. This must be the same size as the matrix specified by themessage. It must be a 3 plane matrix.

messages.name: reset
messages.description: Reset all parameters to the default state and clear any stored mesh data.

messages.name: tangent_matrix
messages.digest: Specifies a matrix of tangent values
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol, specifies a matrix of tangent values. This must be the same size as the matrix specified by themessage. It must be a 3 plane matrix.

messages.name: texcoord_matrix
messages.digest: Specifies a matrix of texture coordinates
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol, specifies a matrix of texture coordinate values. This must be the same size as the matrix specified by themessage. It can be a 2, 3, or 4 plane matrix.

messages.name: vertex_attr_matrix
messages.digest: Specify a matrix of arbitrary per-vertex data.
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol, specifies a matrix of arbitrary per-vertex data

messages.name: vertex_matrix
messages.digest: Specify a matrix of vertex values
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol, specifies a matrix of vertex values. It can be 3 or 4 planes.
